attributes.name: Wand of Treasure Finding
attributes.powers:
On your turn, bury this card to examine your location deck until you find a weapon, an item, or an armor; shuffle the location deck and put that card on top.

After playing this card, you may succeed at an Arcane 8 check to recharge this card instead of burying it.
